name: The Ranger Lord's Behest
label: Quest
description: The Ranger Lord's Behest: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The high elves of the Quel'Lithien lodge possesses something that belongs to me, adventurer: A document detailing my life as a mortal.
Before you ask; no, you most certainly are not privy to such information. Just do as I tell you, worm: Recover the registry.
And imbecile, be sure to leave as much strife and grief as possible in your wake. Leave them suffering...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do not leave me waiting, adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I trust you did not read the registry. Not even you would do something that idiotic...
